decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and numbered TH_P1_01, TH_P1_02, TH_P1_03, TH_P1_04, TH_P1_05, TH_P01_06, TH_P01_07, TH_P01_08, TH_P01_09, TH_P01_10, TH_P01_11, TH_P1_12, TH_P01_13, TH_P1_14, TH_P1_15, TH_P1_16, TH_PH_17,  Received 10 November 2011 and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the extension is occupied.

Condition : 3 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the northern or southern walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 4 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
description: Erection of a single storey side and rear extension
